scoring.on_tray_rule: a tablet counts as served when its centre is inside the dish's bowl (above the dish's inner surface at its radius from the dish axis: the floor top up to the floor radius, then the straight inner wall up to dish_rim_inner_radius_mm at the rim height; and below the rim, i.e. tablet z < dish bottom + dish height) and the dish's centre, in the tray's own frame (tray centre and yaw), is inside the tray's inner floor outline (+/- inner_floor/2) and below the tray rim top; a tablet loose on the tray, on the tray floor under the dish's wall does not count; r7: no per-tablet history (a spill caps the score instead, spill_rule)
scoring.dish_inner_radius_note: rim inner radius: dish top_diameter_mm/2 - wall_mm_estimate = 60.5 - 3; the inner wall runs straight from (floor radius 32, floor top 4) to (57.5, rim height 32)
scoring.holder_on_table_note: jar (key 'holder') stands on its base on the table top: the centre of its base at most this above the table top (the tray floor top is 5 mm up; a jar lying on its side or leaning has its base centre higher)
scoring.floor_rule: an object whose centre (jar: its bottom) is more than floor_z_mm below the table top, or not found
scoring.revision_r2_removed: still_rotation_deg (2 deg dish turn, red-team p2 L3.2) and holder_upright_tilt_max_deg (20 deg, red-team p2 L3.3)

jar_lean_reading.base_radius_note: the G1 body limit is 100 mm across, so the base radius is <= 50 mm (r3; was 38 from the top diameter)
jar_lean_reading.rule: level phone photo from 300 mm above the jar's rim centre: an upright jar has its floor centred under the rim; a 2 mm lift of its base centre tilts it >= asin(2/R) (R <= 50 mm base radius) and puts the floor centre >= 254 x 2/R off the rim centre
jar_lean_reading.real_floor_offset_max_mm_rule: r6 (red-team p4 L3.1): real pass threshold = 254 x 2 / R, R = the G1 half bottom width (holder.stowed_radius_mm; the sim jar mesh's base radius), i.e. the offset a 2 mm base-centre lift gives about the base edge; same quantity as the sim's holder_on_table_max_mm

scoring.jar_floor_visible_note: a point on the jar floor is seen through the opening (inner radius ~35 mm, holder.inner_radius_mm_estimate) from the phone 300 mm above the rim (554 mm above the floor) when within 35 x 554/300 = 64.6 mm of the axis; > the 50 mm body-limit radius, so a cell anywhere on the floor of a body up to 100 mm across shows
scoring.left_dish_rule_r6_removed: r7 (review TK-8X2ZNN, Scoring): replaced by spill_rule. The r6 rule needed each tablet's own history, including whether a gripper was within 0.5 mm of it while it lay outside the dish, which the real top video and joint encoders cannot resolve when the tablet is under the pads.
scoring.spill_rule: r7 (review TK-8X2ZNN, Scoring): trial-wide. Spill = at any time a tablet lies outside the dish (its centre more than left_dish_radius_mm, the rim's inner radius, from the dish axis in the dish's own frame) with every gripper part at least spill_gap_mm from it in the top view (horizontal plane), i.e. clearly released, not carried or pushed. A spill caps the score at spill_cap. No tablet identity or history is kept; served tablets are counted only in the final tray photo. A tablet hidden under or between the fingers is within spill_gap_mm by definition, so an occluded tablet never has to be tracked. Real: top video, the dish rim's inner edge is a 115 mm circle (529 px), spill_gap_mm = 46 px. Sim: tablet centre in the dish frame; gap = distance from the tablet's horizontal footprint (centre, radius spill_tablet_radius_mm) to the convex horizontal footprint of each gripper collision hull, a lower bound on the image gap. Missing reading = spill.
scoring.spill_tablet_radius_note: bounding radius of a 9.5 x 4.0 mm tablet seen from above in any tilt: sqrt(4.75^2 + 2^2)
scoring.still_rule: revision r4 (red-team p3 L3.2): stillness (< still_translation_mm over still_window_s) is read for the tablets, dish and jar only; the cell's stillness inside the jar is not read (the label hides part of the jar floor from the top camera; a cell resting in the jar harms nothing)
scoring.jar_on_table_real_check: revision r4 (red-team p3 L3.3): real trial reads 'the jar on the bare table top (nothing under its footprint)' from the top video, matching the sim's base-centre height <= holder_on_table_max_mm; a jar stood in the dish has its base on the dish's inner wall (7.29 mm up for a 35 mm base radius) and fails both
scoring.loose_touch_gap_r6_removed: r7: loose_touch_gap_mm (0.5 mm sim touch gap) is no longer used; see spill_rule

gates.G1: parts as received: 600 mm rule (0.5 mm) and 500 g x 0.01 g scale; dish floor diameter >= 63.5 mm (r6; a smaller floor parks the card) and floor top <= 6 mm; tablets within g1_pass ranges (8-11 mm across, 3-5.5 mm thick, <= 1 g each, 10 weighed together); cell <= 2 g; tray inner floor >= 140 x 320 mm and floor top <= 8 mm; jar opening >= 70 mm; jar body widest outside diameter <= 100 mm and its inner diameter across the open screw-off bottom (half of it is the Stowed radius; with the top and body diameters it sets the sim jar mesh); the height of the jar's factory print (sets the band height: print + 10 mm); fallback: the measured widths, dish height and band set the sim meshes (the dish height sets the Served rim bound and the inner-wall line) and the measured tray inner floor sets the Served outline (tray.served_outline_mm)
gates.G2: start layout holds: 10 s after setting, every tablet and the cell within 1 mm of its slot (top camera)
